first_public_date_evidence: The initiating finite-variable-logics source Grohe--Otto, arXiv:1204.1990, was first submitted 2012-04-09. Its 2012-09-03 conference date and 2015 journal date are later. Older prior literature is separately listed for comparison, not used as this source date.
integrity: Mathematical proof supplied by a uniform extension lemma; finite scripts corroborate but cannot prove the unbounded statement. Priority provisional; no independent mathematical validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification only for finite projective planes in point/line-sorted incidence first-order logic of variable width at most four without counting. No classification at larger widths, with counting, or among arbitrary incidence structures.
title: Four-variable collapse of the finite projective-plane incidence theories
